title: Hearty Woodfired Chicken Bake
description: A classic American-inspired dish featuring chicken baked to perfection in a woodfired oven. This hearty bake is a staple for any meal.
instructions: Rinse the chicken breast and pat it dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together the chopped onion, minced garlic, and chopped liver (if using).
Season the chicken breast with the woodfired seasoning blend and rub it all over.
Place the chicken breast in a baking dish and brush it with olive oil.
Sprinkle the chopped onion and garlic mixture over the chicken breast.
Pour the chicken broth over the chicken breast and sprinkle with melted butter.
Sprinkle the woodfired bread crumbs and parmesan cheese over the top of the chicken breast.
Bake the chicken breast in the preheated woodfired oven for 25-30 minutes, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Remove the chicken breast from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
